content.text:
Finding submitted as a **deviation** at the fallback level.

**What I found (§4.1, §4.2):**
- Mutual convenience exit on 90 days' written notice — this already satisfies both fallback notice elements (Customer 60–90 days; Vendor at least 90 days).
- **Fail 1:** the notice "shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated," so HDI's exit is not tied to the end of the then-current one-year term — a mid-term walk-away, not term-end non-renewal.
- **Fail 2:** our exit triggers an uncapped Termination Payment (trailing 12-month Net Sales less $800,000, halved), far above the three-months-of-fees fallback cap.

**Cure (two surgical provisos, minimality gate ok:true):**
1. §4.1 — any Termination Date specified by HDI must be the end of the then-current term.
2. §4.2(a) — Termination Payment capped at the fees payable for the three months preceding the Termination Date; the existing zero-floor in 4.2(b) and quarterly instalments in 4.2(c) remain coherent under the cap.

I did not push to preferred (30 days / pro-rata refund) because fees here are paid monthly in arrears on Net Sales, so there are no prepaid fees to refund; the fallback is the shortest complete fix.
